let currentPlayer = 'X';
let score = 0;

function check_win() {
  // Check rows
  for (let row of board) {
    if (row[0] === row[1] && row[1] === row[2] && row[0] !== '') {
      return true;
    }
  }
  // Check columns
  for (let col = 0; col < 3; col++) {

      return true;

    return true;

    return true;
  }
  return false;

function check_draw() {
  for (let row of board) {
    if (row.every(cell => cell === '')) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;

  if (currentPlayer === 'X') {

}

    alert(`Cell ${index + 1} is occupied by ${currentPlayer}.`);
    return;
  }
}

// Start game
function startGame() {
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const cell = e.target.dataset.cell;
    handleClick(cell);
  });
}
